description: Implementation of memory overlap detection and assertions for tensor memory regions in PyTorch's ATen library.

methods.name: has_internal_overlap
methods.description: Checks if a tensor has internal memory overlap based on its implementation details.

methods.name: assert_no_internal_overlap
methods.description: Asserts that a tensor does not have internal memory overlap.

methods.name: get_overlap_status
methods.description: Determines the memory overlap status between two tensors.

methods.name: assert_no_partial_overlap
methods.description: Asserts that two tensors do not partially overlap in memory.

methods.name: assert_no_overlap
methods.description: Asserts that two tensors do not overlap in memory.
